description: React component for a full-featured note editor with markdown support, autosave, tagging, folder management, and multiple view modes.

methods.name: triggerAutosave
methods.description: Sets a timeout to automatically save note content and title after a debounce period.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the note title input, updates state, and triggers autosave.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the note content textarea, updates state, and triggers autosave.

methods.name: handleTagToggle
methods.description: Toggles the presence of a tag on the current note.

methods.name: handleFolderChange
methods.description: Changes the folder of the current note.

methods.name: handleArchive
methods.description: Toggles the archived status of the current note.

methods.name: formatSavedTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a time string for display.
